caption: The drawing depicts a single object—a lidded pitcher or teapot—rendered in pencil or charcoal on an off-white background. The vessel has a round, bulbous body with a wide base, a curved spout on the right side, and an arched handle on the left. The lid is dome-shaped with a finial knob on top. Shading and highlights on the surface suggest the material is metal, as evidenced by smooth, reflective areas and darker shadows that define the form and give the impression of a polished surface. There are no additional objects or background details included in the composition. The overall appearance of the vessel is monochrome, utilizing various tones of gray to depict light, shadow, and reflections.
title: Pewter Pitcher
